summary: Land plan-061 (README layout contract standardization) onto main from f593c21. Pass 4 of 4; the pass-3 blocker (index.md missing a bullet for the operator-filed NEW-draft-frontmatter-conflict.md draft) is fixed in f593c21, okf-index-drift is clean across 66 bundles, and the FULL validation tier re-ran green (65/65). Upstream: 6 issues get a comment; only #315 and #244 are also closed. #247, #273 and #149 are `partial` - they receive a comment and STAY OPEN; a close on any of them is refused here, and #273's disposition was deliberately corrected include->partial in plan.md so that its close is not required. #291 is `deferred` (requires_mention false) - comment only, discretionary. One residual open bead (yf-mol-4cyz.6.6) mirrors as a single group; with no assets/upstream-grant.md present, L17 is PROPOSE-ONLY and files nothing. Gates .7 and .8 are already closed; the reconcile gate .9 resolves via the L8 close chain. THE LANDING DOES LESS THAN A FULL LAND IN EXACTLY ONE RESPECT: L19 (yf self install redeploy) is SKIPPED by explicit operator direction - the redeploy will be run from the primary checkout on main in a separate session after this land succeeds, per AGENTS.md's requirement that the sync run only from a clean, in-sync local main. Nothing else is skipped. The stripped frontmatter on the draft bodies is a recorded operator decision (audit-close non-halting) and is not re-litigated.

upstream_writes.rationale: disposition `include`, required_end_state CLOSED, requires_mention true. The plan claims delivery of this issue in full, so the attributed comment must land BEFORE the close - an unattributed close is an unproven reconciliation. Comment then close, in that order.
disposition `include`, required_end_state CLOSED, requires_mention true. Same contract as #315: the plan delivered it, the comment attributes the closure, the close follows the comment.

disposition `partial`, required_end_state OPEN, requires_mention true. The remaining half is still real work, so the issue must survive this landing; but what THIS plan did has to be recorded upstream or the deferred half becomes invisible. Comment only - no close.

disposition `partial` (corrected from `include` in plan.md by a prior pass precisely so no close is owed), required_end_state OPEN, requires_mention true. Comment records the delivered half; the issue stays open for the remainder.
disposition `partial`, required_end_state OPEN, requires_mention true. Comment only; the unfinished remainder keeps the issue open.

disposition `deferred`, required_end_state OPEN, requires_mention FALSE. A deferral is a non-action - the row records a scoping decision taken in this plan, not work done on the issue - so this comment is DISCRETIONARY, not owed (REQ-PLAN-074 as amended by plan-048 D-7). It is enabled because a draft exists and a written deferral is cheaper for the next reader than a silent one. It must never become a close.

upstream_refusals.refused_because: plan.md Issue 5.5 groups #247 with #315 and #244 under one 'update with outcomes' task, which reads as a close for all three. #247's disposition is `partial` with required_end_state OPEN. Closing it would assert delivery the plan does not claim and would erase the deferred half from the only place anyone tracks it. Comment only.

#273 was originally dispositioned `include` (end state CLOSED); a prior pass corrected it to `partial` in plan.md on the finding that only part of it shipped. Honouring the original close would contradict the corrected disposition and the manifest's required_end_state OPEN. Comment only.

residual_bead_groups.proposed_title: gate_consistency.py has a vacuous-PASS blind spot: it reports PASS with zero gates examined
residual_bead_groups.rationale: Single residual open bead, so the grouping is trivial, but it is a genuine group of one by shared cause rather than by epic: it is the only open work whose cause is the checker's inability to distinguish 'all gates consistent' from 'no gates were looked at'. The other still-open ids under yf-mol-4cyz are the molecule, its epics, the reconcile task and the reconcile gate - all closed by the L8-L12 chain of this landing, not residue to mirror. NOTE: with no assets/upstream-grant.md in the bundle, L17 is PROPOSE-ONLY - it prints the proposed `gh issue create` and files nothing. This group is a proposal, not a write.

gate_adjudications.manifest_says: gate 'checker is sensitive before backfill' - already closed
gate_adjudications.rationale: Already closed; exp-005 (checker-red-run) is the recorded evidence that the checker went red before the backfill, so the condition the gate stands for is genuinely met, not merely mechanically true.

gate_adjudications.manifest_says: gate 'no install.sh reference survives' - already closed
gate_adjudications.rationale: Already closed; the README/SKILL sweep in the merge preview covers every skill surface that carried the reference. The work behind the gate is finished, so its closed state is not a false green.

Resolve via the L8 close chain, and only via it. The gate stands for the upstream reconciliation actually happening, so it must NOT be resolved ahead of L7: if the reconcile writes are skipped or fail, this gate closing would be exactly the mechanically-true / substantively-unfinished false green this adjudication exists to catch.

steps.l19_redeploy: skip:OPERATOR-DIRECTED SKIP, not a lander judgement. The operator has directed that `yf self install` must not run from this session; a separate session will run the redeploy from the primary checkout on main after this land succeeds. This is also the conduct AGENTS.md prescribes - the sync bakes whatever tree it builds into the binary and deploys it to every harness, so it is valid only from a clean local main in sync with origin, which a plan-execute session is not. L19 is `skippable` in the manifest, so this narrows the landing rather than widening it. CONSEQUENCE THE OPERATOR MUST SEE: after this land, the installed yf skill tree is STALE with respect to main - the plan's skills/ changes are merged and pushed but not deployed until that follow-up session runs `yf self install --from-build --build` (add `--allow-permissions-write` if the config half is wanted).
